anatomy: Large serpentine alien with a thick, muscular body covered in overlapping scales; no limbs; large, lidless eyes with slitted pupils
coloration: Iridescent teal and dark emerald scales with glowing cyan bioluminescent patches along the spine; eyes are a piercing, pale yellow
attire_and_adornment: Enclosed in a water-filled glass pressure suit; head is protected by a heavy, high-tech metallic helmet with integrated crystals and sensory arrays
posture_and_expression: Coiled within the glass vessel; head is raised and alert; gaze is focused and predatory
distinctive_traits: The aquatic nature of the environment inside the suit suggest an origin on an ocean world or gas giant with high atmospheric pressure
